StepDescription: Enter username on the login page
Enter password on the login page
Click Login button to access the application
-- CLINICS NAVIGATION --
Click Clinics tab in My Work to navigate to the Clinics section
Wait for the Clinics view to load
Enter clinic name to search for the available CDC clinic session
Click Find to search for clinic sessions matching the entered name
Wait for clinic session search results to load
Select available clinic session row from search results
Click OK to confirm clinic session selection and open the clinic diary
Wait for clinic diary with available time slots to load
Click on an empty time slot within the selected clinic session diary
Click Book link to initiate the appointment booking workflow
-- PATIENT REGISTRATION --
Wait for the patient basic search form to load
Generate a random surname for unique patient registration
Enter the generated random surname in the patient search field
Click Find to confirm no existing patient record with the generated surname
Wait for patient search results to load
Click Registration to initiate new patient creation via the registration roadmap
Wait for patient registration roadmap Section 1 to load
Enter patient forename in registration Section 1
Enter patient city of residence in registration Section 1 address fields
Select patient country of residence in registration Section 1 address fields
Click Next to navigate to Section 2 of the registration roadmap
Wait for registration roadmap Section 2 to load
Select patient country of birth in Section 2 additional demographics
Select patient nationality in Section 2 additional demographics
Select patient ethnicity as mandatory demographic field in Section 2
Click Finish to submit all registration details and complete the registration roadmap
Wait for NHS number allocation confirmation prompt
Click Yes to confirm NHS number allocation for the new patient
Wait for visitor status confirmation prompt
Click No to confirm patient is not a visitor and NHS number is permanently assigned
Wait for registration confirmation popup with NHS number and PAS ID
Capture PAS ID from registration confirmation message for later use
Click OK to dismiss the registration confirmation popup
-- CLINIC BOOKING FORM --
Wait for Clinic Book Appointment form to load after patient registration
Select appointment location for the clinic booking
Select appointment type for the clinic booking
Select appointment priority for the clinic booking
Click Create Referral to link a referral to this clinic appointment
Select service type in the referral details form
Select referral source in the referral details form
Select referral priority in the referral details form
Select referral type in the referral details form
Click Finish Now to complete the referral creation and return to booking form
Click Finish Now to complete the clinic appointment booking
Wait for clinic diary to reload after appointment booking
Validate appointment status is Booked: verify Edit Booking link is present on clinic diary
-- MANAGE APPOINTMENT STATUS: ARRIVED --
Click Manage Appointment Status to update the appointment to Arrived
Wait for Manage Appointment Status form to load
Select Arrived as the appointment event status
Select attendance status for the Arrived event
Click Finish Now to save the Arrived appointment status
Wait for clinic diary to reload after Arrived status update
-- SELECT ARRIVED PATIENT AND VIEW EPR --
Select the arrived patient row from the clinic diary
Wait for the patient context panel to load with arrived patient details
Click View EPR link to open the arrived patient Electronic Patient Record
Wait for the EPR view to load
-- NAVIGATE TO FORMS EPR TAB --
Click Forms button in the EPR view to navigate to the Forms EPR section
Wait for the Forms EPR section to load
-- INITIATE CDC FORM --
Click Initiate link to start a new CDC form initiation
Wait for the Form Initiation search page to load
Click Advanced Search to expand the form name search options
Enter the CDC form name in the advanced search field to locate the form
Click Find to search the form library for the CDC form
Wait for CDC form search results to load
Click on the CDC form name in the search results to select it
Record and verify the CDC form name is displayed correctly in the search results
Check the CDC form row to select it for initiation
Click Next to proceed to the CDC form data entry section
Wait for the CDC form data entry section to load
-- ENTER MANDATORY CDC FORM DETAILS --
Enter the service or team name as a mandatory CDC form field
Select the Assessment Part Of value from the clinical assessment selector
Select the Location of Assessment from the clinical assessment selector
Select the Care Staff responsible for the CDC assessment
Set the current login user as the care staff for this CDC form
Click Finish to save and submit the CDC form initiation
Wait for the Clinic Peg Board to load after CDC form submission
Verify automatic navigation back to the Clinic Peg Board after CDC form submission
-- SECOND VIEW EPR: VALIDATE CDC FORM --
Select the arrived patient row from the clinic diary to open context panel
Wait for patient context panel to reload
Click View EPR to open the patient EPR for CDC form validation
Wait for the EPR view to load
Click Forms button to navigate to the Forms EPR section for validation
Wait for Forms EPR section to load with the CDC form list
-- VALIDATE LIST AND DETAILS TABS --
Wait for the Forms list view to load
Validate the CDC form is shown as Initiated in the List tab
Click the Details tab to view the full CDC form details
Validate the CDC form details are displayed correctly in the Details tab
-- CONTINUE FORM --
Click Continue Form link to re-open the CDC form and verify previously entered data
Wait for the Continue Form page to load with previously entered CDC form data
Verify previously entered CDC form name is displayed in the Continue form view
Click Today to stamp the continuation date for the CDC form
Click Finish to save the continued CDC form
Wait for the Forms view to reload after saving the continued form
-- CORRECT FORM --
Click the Correct button to initiate a correction of the CDC form
Wait for the Reason for Correction dialog to load
Select the reason for correcting the CDC form from the dropdown
Click OK to confirm the correction reason and open the CDC form for editing
Wait for the CDC form to open in correction edit mode
Modify the Assessment Part Of field with updated details during correction
Click Finish to save the corrected CDC form details
Wait for Forms list to reload after saving the corrected form
-- RE-VALIDATE AFTER CORRECTION --
Validate the CDC form List tab shows Continued status after correction
Click the Details tab to verify the corrected form details are saved
Validate the corrected CDC form details are displayed in the Details tab
-- COPY FORM --
Click the Copy Form button to initiate form copy operation
Wait for the Copy Form options to appear
Click Copy Entire Form Details to copy all CDC form data to a new form instance
Wait for the Copy Form page to load with all copied CDC form data
Add current login user as the care staff in the copied CDC form
Click Finish to save the copied form with new values
Wait for Forms list to reload after saving the copied form
-- VALIDATE COPIED FORM IN LIST AND DETAILS TABS --
Validate the newly copied CDC form appears as Initiated in the List tab
Click the Details tab to verify the copied form details are correct
Validate the copied CDC form details are displayed correctly in the Details tab
-- FINALISE DRAFT FORM 1 --
Click on Draft Form 1 in the List tab to select it for finalisation
Click Finalise Form link to begin the finalisation process for the selected Draft form
Wait for the Finalise Form page to load
Select the action to perform on the form during the finalisation step
Click Finish to finalise the CDC form
Wait for Forms list to reload after finalising the form
-- MARK AS OBSOLETE --
Click Mark as Obsolete link to initiate the obsolete marking process for the CDC form
Wait for the Mark as Obsolete justification form to load
Click reason for cancellation selector to expand cancellation reason options
Select specific cancellation reason justification for marking the CDC form as obsolete
Click Finish to submit the Mark as Obsolete action
Validate that the Obsolete status update confirmation popup is displayed
Click OK to confirm and close the Obsolete status confirmation popup
Wait for Forms list to reload after marking form as obsolete
-- PREVIEW FORM --
Click Print Form link to access Print and Preview options for the CDC form
Wait for the Select Printer page to load
Click Print Preview to verify all displayed CDC form information is correct
Click Finish to close the Print Preview and return to the Forms view
Click Logout to exit the application
Confirm logout by clicking Yes
